newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends weaker but at highs, cocoa stron.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends weaker but at highs, cocoa stron.

text.p: COFFEE - Still in negative territory but key Sept claws back lost ground to end constructively at $1,860 high, down $5 on day but up on $1,780 open.
COCOA - Ends firmer boosted by fund, spec buying with nearby positions at highs. Sept up 17 at 1,135 stg.
SUGAR - Tightly mixed at 1612 GMT. Aug unchanged at $323.00.
